latestVersion.changelog:
free-hd-simple 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Instantly edit and export HD videos (up to 1080p MP4) from clips up to 500MB.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, and common audio/image formats.
- Fast, free AI-powered editing on cloud GPUs (30–60 seconds typical per export).
- Simple authentication: auto-obtains anonymous token for 7 days/100 credits.
- Easy workflows: just upload, describe edits, and download your result.
- Includes clear error handling, progress updates, and export guidance for new users.
